root_cause: PR #7158 changed source-ingest PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS to allowlist when PANTHEON_COLLECTOR_HOST is set, but services/source_ingestion/test_compose_activation.py still asserted the old '${PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS:-deny}' literal, so CI went red.
fix: Merged the source branch and updated the compose-activation assertion to the new expression, plus explicit fail-closed checks: with PANTHEON_EXTERNAL_EGRESS and PANTHEON_COLLECTOR_HOST unset the value is empty and resolve_mode() returns deny.
note: Source PR also showed a Smoke acceptance failure ('accepts at most 1 arg(s), received 2') not reproduced or addressed here.
